title: Joining Salvaggio after the crash on banjo
summary: He joined the group a few months after the 1929 crash when it needed a banjo or guitar player, practicing from a chord book.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: If the crash was October of twenty-nine.
I think it was October twenty-nine. Yeah, it was.
Late October. I don't remember it too well myself. But anyway, Salvatio, were you with him when the crash hit or not?

No. No, I went with him after things dwindled down and all that, after that three or four months of working day and night. Then I went with my first group. Then I was approached by a friend of mine to join this first group that had been organized for about two months, the Salvatio group, because they needed a guitar or banjo.
So when the crash came, you knew something about the banjo, enough to be able to... Well, I was practicing, you know. Yeah, and you could cut it with Salvatio.
Yeah, I was going through that dollar book that I bought with all those chords. Yeah, well. Even though I didn't have too much time to practice.
